statement: Two publicly archived 0x057e:0x0337 enumeration dumps disagree on device bMaxPacketSize0: one reports 8 bytes and the other 64 bytes, although their interface and interrupt endpoint layouts agree. The corpus cannot identify whether this reflects genuine adapter variants, compatible clones or other acquisition differences; no single canonical EP0 value is validated.

applicability.revision: public reports for 0x057e:0x0337; hardware revision unverified
applicability.scope: Reported control endpoint packet size conflict; device provenance and variant unknown
